premises.text: Today's heaters waste waiting water, control temperature poorly, waste energy, and fail when internals overheat
premises.evidence_span: doesn't save water. It's difficult to control the temperature. It's not energy efficient and the things inside that get really hot to heat the water break

premises.text: HeatWorks heats only the water via electronic controls and water resistance—no elements or burners
premises.evidence_span: the only thing that gets hot inside this water heater is the hot water itself

premises.text: App connectivity enables presets such as scald-safe baby mode and usage/cost reporting
premises.evidence_span: One of the presets we like, we call the baby preset, which is where you can set the temperature to a temperature where there will never be any scalding

premises.text: Utilities can limit maximum power during peak demand
premises.evidence_span: the utility will be able to control the maximum amount of power that the Model 1 can use during times of peak demand

premises.text: Three unique retrofit applications—booster, extender, turbocharger—create a new install market on existing heaters
premises.evidence_span: three unique applications that only works with our technology

value.text: Redefine how the world heats and uses water with instant, efficient heating
value.evidence_span: redefine how the world heats and uses water

secondary_value.text: Save roughly a quarter of energy and a fifth of water used
secondary_value.evidence_span: save 24% of the energy you use and 20% of the water

causal_links.evidence_span: We solved all four of those problems
we've created a whole brand new market

notes: Utility peak control kept as its own condition within the electronics domain because speaker marks why it matters separately. Quantitative savings placed in secondary_value rather than a duplicate premise.
